title: 2016 to 2018: Bug tracker, form handling, the HUD, and authentication helper
description: Student Hall of Fame entries and add-on developments from 2016-2018: Bug tracker, form handling, ZAP HUD, and authentication helper
narrative:
Logging in to an application and filling in its forms by hand is probably tedious for testers working through a large site, so help for both was an obvious area for student work. The Student Hall of Fame includes Sanchit Kapoor's bug tracker support, a 2016 Summer GSoC project. Form handling is credited to three students, Ryan Wehe, Christopher Laguna and Rian Franey, under Mozilla Winter of Security 2016.

The bug tracker work shows in this record as a commit of August 2016, "Added help for Bug Tracker add-on". A Form Handler Extension commit by Ryan Wehe is dated March 2017. A Mozilla wiki page on the form handling work is cited as evidence.

David Scrobonia's ZAP HUD, directly mentored from 2016 to 2018, lives in its own repository, zap-hud. A zaproxy commit of December 2018 included the HUD in the live Docker image. A June 2019 commit removed that step. A June 2019 commit, the same month as release 2.8.0, lists the HUD at version 0.4.0 among the add-ons bundled with ZAP. It is still in the main add-ons list in release 2.17.1, and at the current head it is at version 0.19.0.

Kajan Mohanagandhirasa's authentication helper, a 2018 Summer project, is listed. The zaproxy history has pull requests from the GitHub user KajanM merged between May and August 2018, including one for dynamic token authentication. A commit by kajan of May 2018 added support for an ACSRF token in post-based authentication.

chapters.title: Bug tracker support
chapters.text: Sanchit Kapoor's Bug tracker support (2016 Summer, GSoC) shows as "Added help for Bug Tracker add-on" (2016-08-27).

chapters.title: Form handling
chapters.text: Three students (Ryan Wehe, Christopher Laguna, Rian Franey) are listed for form handling in Mozilla Winter of Security 2016. The commit "Form Handler Extension" by Ryan Wehe is dated 2017-03-22.

chapters.title: ZAP HUD
chapters.text: David Scrobonia's ZAP HUD (2016 to 2018, directly mentored) lives in its own repository, zap-hud. In zaproxy, the commit "Include the HUD add-on in live Docker image" (2018-12-05) builds it from source into the live Docker image, and "Fix Docker live image" (2019-06-10) removes that step. "Add main add-ons" (2019-06-07, the date of release 2.8.0) lists the HUD, version 0.4.0, among the add-ons bundled with ZAP. The HUD is still in the main add-ons list in release 2.17.1 and at the current head, at version 0.19.0.

chapters.title: Authentication helper
chapters.text: Kajan Mohanagandhirasa's Authentication helper (2018 Summer) is listed. The zaproxy history has pull requests from the GitHub user KajanM merged between 2018-05-28 and 2018-08-28, among them #4682 (dynamic-token-authentication), #4696 (renew-cookie-before-each-login) and #4946 (add-new-default-acsrf-token); a commit by kajan on 2018-05-21 is "support acsrf token in post-based authentication".
